text:
sam: planning to deploy a small hotfix to model-routing today 21:00 UTC. intents: fix fallback when capacity low. canary plan 0.1% -> 1% -> 5% over ~30m. need smoke owner and rollback ready. pinging @dana @lee

Dana: I can own smoke checks. I'll run the smoke suite + manual chat walkthrus. available at 20:45 UTC.

lee: I'll be on deploy and watch latency / errors. set alert: 5xx_rate > 0.5% for 5m.

maria: quick Q — does this flip the fallback flag? we should validate in load test that fallback routing doesn't amplify errors.

sam: yes flag is enable-fallback=true. canary in us-west only first, then expand if stable.

ops-bot: /deploy-plan
```
canary schedule: 0.1% -> 1% (+10m) -> 5% (+30m)
regions: us-west
rollback: revert flag + scale-stable
```

dana: smoke checklist:
- run smoke jobs (smoke/model-routing)
- spot-check 10 sample prompts
- trace sampling: check kv cache miss rate
- verify token counts within baseline
I'll post results here.

lee: rollback plan: revert flag, drain canary pool, shift traffic back to stable. est rollback 5m.

maria: code-review ping @sam — PR #4321 touches routing ACL, LGTM with one nit.

sam: thanks — deploying from tag `release/2026-03-18-hotfix` (command below)
```
./deploy --tag release/2026-03-18-hotfix --canary 0.001,0.01,0.05 --regions us-west --strategy light-touch
```

dana: 20:50 smoke job: PASS 12/12. sample prompts look normal. tail latency +20ms but within SLO.

lee: monitoring: no 5xx spike, CPU +8% on canary instances. logs clean.

ops-bot: canary incremented to 1% at 21:01 UTC

sam: holding 10m at 1%.

lee: still green, no errors observed.

maria: if token generation increases >15% from baseline we rollback immediately.

sam: incrementing to 5% now.

ops-bot: canary incremented to 5% at 21:11 UTC

dana: final checks: smoke suite green, trace sample ok. :thumbsup:

sam: thanks team — leaving canary live for 2h before considering full rollout. will open follow-up thread if anything to report. :tada:
